messages:
Sophia L: Nightly eval alerted on promptset v2 rebaseline — higher failure rate on 'summarize_account_activity' prompt group. see eval-bot summary below.

Matt B: ugh, saw that. rough numbers?

Sophia L: eval-bot: regression +7.4% failure rate vs baseline on model redwood-instruct-3b-q4f. failed cases are mostly hallucinations or truncated lists.

eval-bot: [nightly-run id: nr-2024-06-15-03]
eval-bot: metric: pass_rate (>=0.8) baseline 0.92 -> current 0.857 (delta -0.063)
eval-bot: top failing prompt_ids: PSA_142, SUMM_88, ACT_201
eval-bot: attached artifact: s3://redwood-evals/nr-2024-06-15/artifacts/regression_samples.json

Anya R: Did anything else change besides promptset? quantization? kernel updates?

Sophia L: No kernel changes in infra. We did roll promptset v1 -> v2 yesterday (rebase + normalization). Also ran a quantization experiement last week on an isolated canary (q4f) but this regression reproduces on both float32 and q4f variants when using v2 prompts.

Kai: can you paste a couple of raw prompt diffs? curious if the wording tweak could shift instruction framing.

Sophia L: sure — here's a minimal diff that we think is suspicious:
```diff
- Summarize the recent activity on this account. Include transactions, logins, and alerts.
+ Summarize recent activity for this account. List transactions, logins, alerts, and any notable anomalies.
```

Sophia L: sample generation on v1 (good):
"Transactions: $45 debit, login 2024-06-01 14:02, no alerts."

Sophia L: sample generation on v2 (bad):
"It appears there were suspicious transfers and multiple failed logins. Recommend contacting support."  <-- hallucinated transfers

Matt B: Adding "notable anomalies" probably widened the model's scope so it over-infers. v2 introduced extra probing language.

Jamal: can we run an A/B eval: model + promptset v1 vs v2 on the failing subset? need to measure precision of assertions (hallucination rate) not just pass/fail.

Sophia L: queued A/B job now: nr-ab-2024-06-15-2. will include float32 and q4f, and generate detailed error tags (hallucination, omission, truncation).

eval-bot: job nr-ab-2024-06-15-2 started — ETA ~40m

Anya R: If A/B confirms v2 is worse, we should consider a temporary rollback of the promptset until prompt authors rebaseline. Any blockers on rollback?

Kai: ops: rollback is trivial for hosted but for Dedicated customers we need a config migration notice. Ops: @ops please chime in.

Matt B: Also need product approval for prompt wording changes that alter behaviour. Who signed off v2?

Sophia L: v2 was reviewed by PM (Anya) and Docs, but we missed a follow-up sanity check with ML. See PR #482 in prompts repo.

Anya R: yep that was me, I approved the editorial rewording for clarity. I didn't intend to broaden scope. My bad — we should add guard rails.

Jamal: Proposed remediations: 1) revert to v1 for nightly and canaries, 2) add explicit constraint lines to prompts (eg. "Do not infer facts not present in the input"), 3) update promptship checklist to include ML regression smoke.

Sophia L: Agree. For immediate mitigation I recommend reverting v2 for prod/nightly, and running targeted rephrasing for v2 that keeps concision but removes "notable anomalies" phrase.

Kai: Ops: we can toggle promptset pointer for hosted in <10m. For Dedicated customers we can push an override patch but need customer comms.

Matt B: Who's owning the approval to revert? If Anya already owns prompt changes, maybe Anya can approve revert and we document follow-up?

Anya R: I approve rollback now. Please include a postmortem ticket and add me as approver for the rebaseline.

Sophia L: rolling back promptset pointer to v1 in hosted and nightly. will leave Dedicated alone for now and contact account ops for two customers on Dedicated who opted into automatic prompt updates.

eval-bot: rollback action: promptset pointer set -> v1 at 2024-06-15T04:30Z by sophia.l (action id: act-9876)

Sophia L: A/B job finished: nr-ab-2024-06-15-2 results: v1 pass_rate 0.92, v2 pass_rate 0.855. hallucination_rate v1 0.03 -> v2 0.09. consistent across float32/q4f. attaching sample diffs to ticket.

Kai: solid data. next steps: rebaseline v2 with stricter constraints and run a focused eval on hallucination tags before re-approval. Also update promptship checklist.

Jamal: I'll open the follow-up ticket and assign to prompt authors + ML reviewer. recommend adding automated hallucination detectors in nightly that flag any >2x increase.

Anya R: agreed. also adding explicit "do not invent" clause and testing again. I'll coordinate the re-approval once ML signs off.

Matt B: thanks team. cc: @support and @customer-ops so they know rollback occurred for hosted and we're pausing dedicated updates.

Sophia L: closing thread when PM confirms re-approval flow is in place. thanks all :thumbsup:
